name: normal initialization is idempotent
steps: initialize new repository twice
expected: All exported records including audit timestamps unchanged

name: employee registration
steps: registerEmployee, export linked records
expected: Exactly one Person, Employment, Assignment and Compensation added; companyId set

name: duplicate employee number rejected
steps: register same employeeNumber
expected: Full data unchanged

name: missing company repair and repeated initialization
steps: remove companyId only, initialize twice
expected: Only companyId and one repair audit change; histories and PKs unchanged

name: ambiguous organization stays unresolved
steps: remove companyId; change assignment organization to missing ID; initialize twice
expected: Original employment remains; single stable review audit; no invented company

name: personnel transfer valid and invalid
steps: transfer to existing organization, reject pre-hire date
expected: New assignment preserves old ID with previous-day end; invalid input changes nothing

name: same-day personnel action cannot create reversed interval
steps: submit promotion on current assignment start date
expected: Reject without creating effectiveTo before effectiveFrom

name: payroll targets include new employment
steps: createRun and inspect entries
expected: New employment matches entry and Person, no duplicate entries

name: attendance change and allowance sync
steps: save monthly attendance; invalid batch; syncAttendance; calculate
expected: Invalid batch atomic; overtime input 10; positive overtime calculated

name: validation confirmation close and source edit protection
steps: validate, confirm, reject premature close, close attendance, close payroll; edit name
expected: Closed entries/results unchanged; recalculation and attendance edit rejected

name: withholding generation and invalid draft
steps: generate draft from closed results; validate reviewed draft; generate HTML; reject unreviewed
expected: A01 totals match included results; company rendered; no source mutation

name: retirement calculation and locked edit
steps: calculateRetirement; confirm; attempt recalculation and missing employment
expected: Positive service days; confirmed result unchanged after errors

name: year-end settlement save and validation
steps: save; verify derived settlement; reject invalid employee; confirm; reject edit
expected: Settlement -25000; all error paths preserve stores

name: ATS rejects unaccepted offer
steps: convertCandidate with DRAFT offer
expected: All stores unchanged

name: ATS conversion and duplicate conversion
steps: convert accepted candidate; repeat conversion
expected: One Person and Employment; company and candidate links; duplicate causes no writes

name: ATS rejects organization from another company
steps: convert accepted candidate with foreign company organization
expected: Reject without Person or Employment writes

name: personnel rejects nonexistent organization
steps: submit immediate organization transfer
expected: Reject without assignment/event/audit changes

name: daily registration cannot overwrite existing Person
steps: createDailyWorker with existing regular Person ID
expected: Reject and preserve original Person and linked payroll

name: daily registration creates separate linked person
steps: createDailyWorker
expected: New daily worker and Person; no Employment mutation

name: paid payroll remains immutable
steps: mark closed run paid; edit source name; attempt calculate, validate, delete run, edit entry
expected: Paid state retained; entry and result snapshots unchanged

name: registration mid-write failure rolls back
steps: inject synchronous Assignment.add error after Person and Employment requests
expected: No partial Person/Employment/Assignment/Compensation or audit saved

name: company repair preserves nonempty closed payroll and attendance
steps: remove companyId; reopen after closed payroll exists
expected: Only companyId and repair audit change; entries/results/attendance and all IDs preserved

name: missing Person and conflicting organization never inferred
steps: register isolated employee; remove companyId; point Person to missing ID; then conflicting organization
expected: No company invention; stable review record; other histories preserved

name: multiple companies do not cause arbitrary repair
steps: add second company; remove companyId; reopen
expected: Missing company preserved; stable review marker available
